content: {"praised":["Wonderful dancing and singing performances throughout the film.","All-star cast including Myrna Loy, John Barrymore, Nick Lucas.","Color sequence featuring Chinese Fantasy is visually impressive.","Historic record of early sound film, valuable for enthusiasts.","Energetic, light-hearted tone makes it enjoyable."],"criticized":["Lacks humor, many sketches unfunny.","Too much talking, pacing feels slow.","Unconnected sketches make story feel disjointed.","Soft images and poor visual quality in spots.","Offensive portrayal of Chinese characters noted."]}
